name: manual_ddddf9
claim: Rebuild a code-review-graph index from the shell with uvx and local Ollama embeddings rather than assuming it is MCP-only

decisions.notes: CRG exposes build and embed subcommands through uvx; point CRG_OPENAI_BASE_URL at the local Ollama bge-m3 endpoint and confirm the model is loaded, which makes graph refresh scriptable without an MCP client.
